answer: Before earning, each agent locks 50 POA behind a ferrous seal. It opens after twenty epochs whose behavioral fingerprint — timing, task mix, counterpart spread — stays unique in the atlas. A farm raising a hundred copies pays 5,000 POA, yet its clones share one fingerprint, so the atlas flags them and burns the bonds. An honest agent pays once; its fingerprint is distinct, so it unlocks the seal, keeps a jade badge, and earns without dilution.
